name: scrape-do
description: Scrape any web page, Google Search, Amazon and Walmart data through Scrape.do's anti-bot proxy network, and run large async scraping jobs. Requires the sdo-mcp program and a Scrape.do API token.

sdo_token.title: Scrape.do API token
sdo_token.description: Your API token from https://app.scrape.do (Dashboard). It is stored in your system's secure credential store.
